notes.title: Final content update
notes.notes: 5 new girls, it's also now moddable. Plenty of quality of life updates. Thanks for the fish. Tired.

notes.title: I'm sorry.
notes.notes:
I am truly sorry for any inconvenience the slow loading of the game has caused, especially for those on older systems whom have had the game not working at all. It took me long time to find the fault, but on the second report I understood where I had made a mistake.

It is fixed now. This is on me not knowing well enough how my engine works and I truly apologize.

notes.title: It's out
notes.notes: I did it. I said I would release it on valentine's day 2025, and that I did. 5 new girls, new staging. One more update on the horizon with the season 3 extras and modding possibilities.

notes.title: Love Rocket 0.2.666 Small update with 5 girls, upcoming price hike on release
notes.notes:
Rest of the season 2 girls are here along with a few minor fixes. MG, Tama, Clara, The Ensign and a mystery girl are now available to play and unlock. The last clothing item effect bg and voice reacts have been deprecated.

The price will go up to 6.99 after valentines day upon release and the first batch of the last season releasing.

notes.title: Fixed Cao Fen update not working
notes.notes: Removed redundant launch option and compatibility build so the game is working now with the new Cao Fen update, if you have need for the compatibility build, please contact the devs via discord and we'll get you working with achievements included.

notes.title: Love Rocket 0.1.5
notes.notes:
The formosan flying fox emo girl from Taiwan can now be purchased and played against. Unlocking will cost 500 coins.

You will need to have Cheshire completeded to at leas level 3 to be able to purchase Cao Fen

notes.title: Love Rocket 0.1.4
notes.notes: Now we have a music player and undresser! You can undress the girls while playing the stage music if you have completed their level. Also, some additional dialogue has been put into the game (Ella stage 4, maaike stage 4, kay stage 2, Julia stage 2) and Cheshires sad story is now optional.
